source.post_text:
The STAR WARS (1977) teaser trailer played before KING KONG, months before the film’s release.

The effects were unfinished, the score wasn’t by John Williams & the entire teaser had a noticeably darker tone than the audiences eventually fell in love with.https://t.co/2w4OwRA0xY

replies.text: Ah yes, the movie that inspired Starcrash.
replies.author: @JimmyRu68291223

replies.text: Vi el original cuando era niño.
replies.author: @SoyGeorgeBeto

replies.text:
This is amazing. They didn’t even have the branding down.
Despite working at Lucasfilm - I’ve never seen this trailer.
Thanks for sharing.
replies.author: @jasonrmsmith

replies.text: Amazing. We barely had computers back then.
replies.author: @RelaxingNews

replies.text: Fascinating how that unfinished FX and non-Williams score gave the teaser such a brooding edge before the brighter final version took over.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: Slightly too polished and explanatory in neatly contrasting the teaser's tone with the finished film.
